verified_facts: EA publishes composite DTM products at 1m 2m and 10m resolutions
the 1m and 2m products share composite survey lineage
the 10m product is resampled from the 2m composite
bilinear interpolation is used for resampling
the composite products share the 2000-to-2022 survey period
all use OS National Grid alignment
all report source-survey vertical accuracy of plus or minus 15cm RMSE
multiple resolutions from the same lineage are correlated and are not independent evidence by default
quality_effect: Prevents naive independence or RSS assumptions across EA 1m/2m/10m products derived from the same composite lineage.
